author: Da_Baus
body:
Hello Avicus staff, I would like to appeal my ban.
For the most reason I would like to appeal this ban because without avicus MineCraft is getting quite boring with the toxic community but I found that avicus has a really good community.
Also I had made a lot of great friends on avicus and I feel like a let down for doing what I did.
I did ban academy about a week after a got banned because I was so longing to play avicus and it was a stupid idea and I don't know why I did it and I hate myself for it.

I really hope this get accepted thank you for reading this.

-Fraglantia

title: Ban appeal

replies.author: DJ_Barnsey
replies.body:
Hello,
This appeal is denied.

Reason: Evaded using multiple accounts.

Regards,
Lord_Draksis, Avicus Network Senior Moderator.
